name: Money Management
overview: Scripture teaches that God is the source of all wealth and grants the ability to gain it according to His covenant (Deuteronomy 8:18). Believers are called to honor the Lord with their possessions, offering their firstfruits as an act of worship (Proverbs 3:9). Wise money management involves diligent labor and careful stewardship, as wealth gained through honest effort increases, while careless hands lead to poverty (Proverbs 10:4, 13:11). Furthermore, prudent saving and wise spending distinguish the wise from the foolish, with the godly leaving an inheritance for future generations (Proverbs 21:20, 13:22).
